Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: Oxford-Pershing Square Graduate Scholarships
  • Host Institution: University of Oxford, Saïd Business School
  • Location: Oxford, United Kingdom
  • Programme: 1+1 MBA (one-year Master's + Oxford MBA = 2 years total)
  • Positions: Up to 5 fully funded scholarships
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Coverage: Full course fees for both degrees + living stipend
  • Stipend: At least £21,805 per year
  • Application Deadline: 6 January 2027
  • Eligibility: International students

About the Scholarship

The Pershing Square Foundation awards full scholarships to support outstanding students on the Oxford 1+1 MBA programme. Scholars combine a one-year Master's degree with the Oxford MBA, creating an integrated two-year programme designed for ambitious individuals demonstrating leadership potential and commitment to addressing major social and global challenges through scalable and sustainable solutions.

Programme Structure

  • Year 1: Master's degree in chosen field (various options available)
  • Year 2: Oxford MBA at Saïd Business School
  • Integrated programme combining disciplinary depth with business leadership

Eligibility Requirements

  • Apply and be admitted to the Oxford 1+1 MBA programme
  • Apply to both the Master's programme and MBA simultaneously
  • International students eligible (no citizenship restrictions)
  • Must demonstrate leadership potential and commitment to scalable and sustainable solutions to social/global challenges
  • English proficiency required
  • Must meet admission requirements for both programmes

Funding Details

  • Master's Degree: Full course fees covered
  • MBA: Full Oxford MBA course fees covered
  • Living Stipend: At least £21,805 per year
  • Duration: 2 years (full duration of 1+1 MBA)
  • Total Value: Approximately £100,000+ in funding

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.sbs.ox.ac.uk/oxford-experience/scholarships-and-funding/oxford-pershing-square-graduate-scholarships

Source: sbs.ox.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 6 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Apply for the Oxford 1+1 MBA programme by 6 January 2027
  2. Apply for chosen Master's programme by its own deadline (December or January)
  3. Indicate interest in Pershing Square Scholarship in application
  4. Submit transcripts, CV, personal statement, references, and English test scores
  5. Selection based on academic excellence, leadership, and social impact commitment
